title: Selecting Countermeasures against Fake News using Large Language Models for Performance Elicitation

live_model.evidence: "using the model Chat-GPT-4-turbo costs 0,02 € per investigation"; Fig. 4 shows the literal JSON user message sent to the ChatGPT Assistant.

prompt.location: Fig. 4 (user message to the ChatGPT Assistant)
prompt.note: A JSON payload naming the fake-news case, one criterion, and the countermeasure options, asking for a performance rating (very high/high/medium/low).

claim.metric: none (a single demonstration case scored by an MCDA tool (M-Macbeth) from the model's ratings; no ground-truth accuracy is computed)
claim.location: Table 3 (M-Macbeth countermeasure scores for one demonstration case)

data.source: one illustrative fake-news scenario invented by the authors; no dataset released

notes: This is a single-case system/tool demonstration (a DSR prototype piping GPT-4-Turbo ratings into an MCDA tool), not a quantitative evaluation; the paper's own Evaluation section proposes a future expert interview rather than reporting any accuracy metric.
